en.title: Longest Segment with All Prefix Sums Non-Negative
en.description:
Find the longest contiguous segment such that the sum of every non-empty prefix starting from its left end is at least 0. Output 0 if there is no valid non-empty segment.

The standard input format, examples, and test data were written independently by CSWork.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100000), and the second line contains n integers (−10⁹..10⁹). The problem definition includes no extra parameter k.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer required by the problem.
en.explanation: Example 1: the prefix sums of the whole array are 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, all non-negative, so the length is 5. Example 2: every segment starts with a negative element, so the answer is 0. Example 3: the second prefix of [1,−2] is −1, and the first prefix of [−2,3] is −2, so only the single element 1 or 3 can be taken, and the answer is 1.
hints: On the prefix sum array, find for each position the first strictly smaller prefix sum to its right. Every element before it can be included; reaching it fails.
